thoughts.sr: Mali model je ocenio iznenađenje veza: F12 5/5, F50 4/5, F51 4/5, F52 4/5, F5 2/5, F7 2/5, F9 1/5. Procena, ne merenje.
thoughts.en: A small model rated the connections by surprise: F12 5/5, F50 4/5, F51 4/5, F52 4/5, F5 2/5, F7 2/5, F9 1/5. An estimate, not a measurement.

thoughts.sr_refused: Primećujem da je prijem Citizen-sensor-a noviji od prijema SEPA-e, ali njihov instrument i broj vrednosti opisuju prikupljanje, a ne slaganje između merenja. Parking Servis daje prikazanu promenu bez vremena merenja, pa ni njena starost ni vreme te promene nisu utvrđeni. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: Citizen-sensor reception is more recent than SEPA's, but their instrument and value counts describe collection rather than agreement between measurements [F2][F10]. Parking Servis supplies a displayed change without a measurement time, so neither its age nor the time of that change is established [F11][F12].
hypotheses: Perhaps the difference in reception age matters less than unreported measurement timing.
questions: What measurement time accompanies the Parking Servis values?
thoughts.next_check: Check whether Parking Servis publishes a measurement timestamp with its next reception.

thoughts.sr: Razlika u prijemu se smanjila: Sensor.Community je stigao pre 5 min, dok je SEPA stigla pre 15 min. U SEPA satu označenom na izvoru kao 14:00, maksimum PM10 pomerio se sa 29 na 48 µg/m³, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 16 na 31 µg/m³, pri čemu su oba završila u Borči, dok se maksimum NO2 pomerio sa 40 na 29 µg/m³. [F10][F2][F3][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The reception gap has narrowed: Sensor.Community arrived 5 min ago, while SEPA arrived 15 min ago [F10][F2]. In SEPA’s source-labelled 14:00 hour, the PM10 maximum moved from 29 to 48 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 16 to 31 µg/m³, both ending at Borča, while the NO2 maximum moved from 40 to 29 µg/m³ [F3][F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: Maybe the paired PM10 and PM2.5 movements reflect a shared Borča influence, but the record cannot yet establish what is usual [F5][F8][F9][F49].
questions: Will Borča remain the station with the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima in SEPA’s next labelled hour [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda uparena pomeranja PM10 i PM2.5 odražavaju zajednički uticaj u Borči, ali zapis još ne može da utvrdi šta je uobičajeno [F5][F8][F9][F49].
questions_sr: Da li će Borča ostati stanica sa maksimumima PM10 i PM2.5 u sledećem SEPA označenom satu [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Check SEPA’s next labelled hour for the PM10, PM2.5 and NO2 maxima and their stations [F4][F6][F8].

thoughts.sr: Najnoviji prijem sa SEPA bio je pre 27 min, dok je sa Sensor.Community bio pre 7 min. U najnovijem označenom satu, PM10 je dostigao 48 µg/m³, a PM2.5 31 µg/m³ u Borči, dok je NO2 dostigao 29 µg/m³ u Obrenovcu Centar. [F2][F10][F4][F6][F8]

SEPA’s last labelled hour ends 12:00 UTC although our estimate of true UTC is 10:00, so I cannot treat that label as an unqualified observation time [F3].
